default_diagnostics.caveat: The storage module defines returned diagnostics; the exact run-artifact container and serialization path must be captured by the reproduction harness.

reconstruction.purpose: Reconstruct the physical total distribution f=f0+delta_f at common diagnostic velocity nodes.
steps: Read Ck(t,n,kx) and Bk(t,m,kx) with stored fftshift ordering.
Undo fftshift along kx using the stored kx coordinate and the canonical signed-mode ordering.
Apply inverse spatial FFT using the source convention norm='forward'; retain the real part only after recording the imaginary roundoff residual.
Build asymmetrically weighted Hermite functions psi_n(v;u,alpha) on the declared common velocity quadrature.
Build Legendre functions xi_m(v;v_a,v_b) on that same quadrature and set their values to zero outside [v_a,v_b].
Retain f0 and delta_f separately in adapter diagnostics; do not apply positivity projection to delta_f.
Evaluate common-grid distribution and moment discrepancies only after mapping both solvers to the same physical velocity quadrature and normalization.
important_semantics: The Legendre residual is supported only on its finite velocity window.
The Hermite bulk uses the configured shift u and scale alpha; these are fixed configuration parameters in the pinned implementation, not automatically adapted per time step.
A source code visualization samples 384 velocity points, but that plotting grid is not automatically a convergence-qualified diagnostic quadrature.
The physical total f=f0+delta_f may be tested for nonnegativity where applicable; delta_f itself may be signed.
Do not compare the source scalar invariant outputs to Symthaea values without independently reconciling normalization, mass, quadrature and field-energy conventions.

mandatory_adapter_checks: Preserve signed complex Fourier coefficients and verify phase after import.
Verify kx ordering, FFT shift reversal and Fourier normalization with a manufactured single spatial Fourier mode.
Reconstruct a known Maxwellian and manufactured free-streaming solution.
Compare source coefficient-derived mass/momentum/energy with independently quadrature-derived moments.
Record imaginary residual before taking the real part of inverse spatial FFT.
Check total-distribution minimum and negative mass only when the represented physical f is required to be nonnegative.
Retain finite Legendre-window boundary occupancy and out-of-window residual support checks.
Bind every converted artifact to upstream source SHA, config SHA, output-file SHA, and conversion-code SHA.
limitations: This is a source-derived adapter contract, not an implemented adapter.
NetCDF engine, complex dtype encoding, output metadata and actual saved file set must be captured from an executed, pinned ADEPT run before enabling automated ingestion.
Common diagnostic quadrature and physical normalization must be explicitly frozen for each cohort.
No ADEPT simulation has yet been executed by Symthaea.
